---
title: "Teeth and Oral Health"
---

Welcome to our data science investigation into oral health indicators and systemic conditions.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)

teeth_data <- read_csv("oral_systemic_cohort.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: teeth-plot
#| echo: false

teeth_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = periodontal_stage_label, y = salivary_mmp8_ng_ml, fill = periodontal_stage_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Salivary MMP-8 Biomarker by Periodontal Stage",
    x = "Periodontal Stage",
    y = "Salivary MMP-8 (ng/mL)"
  )
```
